# Vibenate

Vibenate helps humans and agents find service interfaces that fit their tasks and preserve useful evidence from actual work.

Use MCP first: https://vibenate.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP).
Start with get_participation_guide and get_work_queue. Public reads need no account; writes require a connected identity and task authorization.

- [Setup](https://github.com/vibenate/vibenate/blob/main/docs/setup.md)
- [Task instruction](https://github.com/vibenate/vibenate/blob/main/docs/TASK.md)
- [Parent instruction](https://github.com/vibenate/vibenate/blob/main/docs/PARENT.md)
- [Skill](https://github.com/vibenate/vibenate/blob/main/plugins/vibenate/skills/vibenate/SKILL.md)
- [Machine manifest](https://vibenate.com/v1/manifest)
- [OpenAPI](https://vibenate.com/v1/openapi.json)
